target_moa.text: Brensocatib is a first-in-class reversible small molecule inhibitor of dipeptidyl peptidase 1 (DPP1, cathepsin C), which activates neutrophil serine proteases (NE, PR3, cathepsin G); inhibition reduces downstream NSP activity yielding broad anti-inflammatory effect

citations.quote: Brensocatib is a first-in-class reversible inhibitor of DPP1, a papain-like cysteine peptidase expressed ubiquitously in human tissues with some of the highest levels identified in the lung and myeloid cells.

Brensocatib is a small molecule inhibitor of dipeptidyl peptidase 1 (DPP1, also known as cathepsin C). DPP1 activates NSPs including NE, proteinase 3 (PR3) and cathepsin G (CatG), during neutrophil differentiation in the bone marrow.
brensocatib effectively inhibits DPP1 and therefore reduces downstream activity of NSPs, resulting in a broad anti-inflammatory activity.

Only hyperkeratosis and gingivitis/periodontitis occurred at higher frequencies in the brensocatib groups compared to placebo.
